facts: The complete original ac_felt01.prefab inventory contains one enabled CubismEyeBlinkController with EyeOpening=1 and BlendMode=2, and two enabled CubismEyeBlinkParameter destinations.

Neither complete original ac_felt01.prefab nor ac_base_felt01.prefab MonoBehaviour inventory contains a serialized CubismAutoEyeBlinkInput instance. Every referenced MonoScript in these inventories was resolved.

The original CubismEyeBlinkController.OnLateUpdate reads EyeOpening and applies it to destinations. Its constructor defaults EyeOpening=1 and BlendMode=2. This controller method does not generate a blink countdown or phase.

Original CubismAutoEyeBlinkInput exists as a metadata type. Its LateUpdate contains a Time.deltaTime countdown, phase evolution and an EyeOpening write. Existence of its class and method is not evidence of a live instance or its configuration.
Original L2D_Eye.Init configures L2D_LookTarget and the Cubism look controller. Its inspected Awake callback calls Init. These methods do not establish an independent eye blink generator.

Original face_nayamu explicitly owns both EyeOpen channels: open through approximately .533 motion seconds, then closes. When its face override has full weight, it covers body eye channels, including act_tameiki's early blink.

Only act_nayamu_w and face_nayamu_w have the exact desired held head/eye/brow/mouth fingerprint in the inspected Felt controller. Original-video arms exclude the act_nayamu crossed-arm held pose for node 15.

act_tameiki contains an early close-open blink and a later closure, but reopens by approximately 1.8 motion seconds. Its body-only curve does not provide the observed long worried closed hold. Adding face_nayamu also covers its distinguishing early blink.
